{{Short description|Chinese theoretical and nuclear physicist}}

'''Huang Zuqia''' ({{zh|s=黄祖洽}}; October 2, 1924 – September 7, 2014) was a Chinese theoretical and nuclear physicist, born in [[Changsha]], [[Hunan]] province who was elected as a member of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] in 1980.<ref>{{Cite book|title=湖南百科全书|author=禹舜主编; 洪期钧副主编|publisher=岳麓书社|year=1999|isbn=|location=长沙|pages=}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book|title=中华当代文化名人大辞典|author=张品兴, 殷登祥, 陈有进等主编|publisher=中国广播电视出版社|year=1992|isbn=9787504315137|location=北京|pages=}}</ref><ref>{{Cite book|title=二十世纪中国名人辞典|author=蔡开松, 于信凤主编; 曾卓明, 周溯源, 赵书刚副主编|publisher=辽宁人民出版社|year=1991|isbn=|location=沈阳|pages=}}</ref><ref>{{cite book|title=中国普通高等学校教授人名录|author=《中国普通高等学校教授人名录》编写组编|publisher=高等教育出版社|year=1988|isbn=7040006162|location=北京|page=}}</ref> He made significant contributions to the theoretical design of China's hydrogen bombs.<ref>{{Cite web|title=氢弹突破的功臣——追记核物理学家黄祖洽|url=https://xsg.tsinghua.edu.cn/info/1004/1790.htm|accessdate=2022-02-07|work=清华大学校史馆}}</ref>
